title: ProjectE board checker report envelope
description: Shared output shape for dfm_emc_check, mask_dam, stitch_density and via_stub. Before consolidation these four tools emitted four different top-level shapes and none carried a schema_version.

params.description: Tool-specific scalars. Previously scattered across the top level.

design.description: The board this report measured, with its digest. REQUIRED: an assertion cannot tie a check to an artifact it cannot hash, and an untieable report is SCREEN_ONLY however good the number in it is. sha256 is null when the path could not be read - loud, not absent.

metrics.description: check name -> violation count, or null when the check measured nothing. Exists because `checks` is a list and the assertion selector grammar addresses a.b paths; without this map a rule can name the tool but cannot point at the check it cares about. NO_COVERAGE is null, NOT 0: a numeric 0 for an unmeasured check compares equal to a threshold and reports PASS on a check that examined nothing - the 0 == 0 agreement drc_gate.py hit on parity_difference_count. The verdict still lives in `checks`.

by_check.description: check name -> {status, scanned, violations}. The name-keyed door into the report that carries COVERAGE, which `metrics` cannot. These are the two halves of one fix, pointing in opposite directions: `metrics` is null for an unmeasured check so a threshold comparison cannot falsely SUCCEED, and `by_check` lets a rule affirmatively assert the check RAN. `by_check.X.status equals PASS` means ran + examined something + clean, because Finding refuses to build a scanned==0 PASS. Null alone turns a vacuous PASS into a type error, which reads as a broken rule rather than an empty check; by_check alone would leave existing metrics.* bindings comparing 0 to 0. Assertions that gate on a measurement bind here. NOTE the denominator is only as honest as the producer: `scanned` must be the population the check actually examined, not a larger set that happens to be non-empty.

$comment: scanned == 0 MUST yield status NO_COVERAGE, never PASS. NOTE: the exit code is currently 1 only when FAIL > 0; NO_COVERAGE exits 0 for backwards compatibility with the documented sibling-tool contract, so a caller MUST inspect summary.NO_COVERAGE and not rely on the exit code alone.
